rationale: Era's work on edge intelligence and sovereign AI infrastructure complements Ming's expertise in verifiable compute and zkVM architecture—both are building cryptographic and systems primitives for decentralized, privacy-preserving AI. Era's conviction that on-device AI will win over centralized cloud solutions pairs naturally with Ming's DAC Economy philosophy and MIPS-based zkVM design, which enables verifiable computation at scale without relying on validator trust.
intro_message: Era Qian, meet Ming Guo — you're both architecting foundational infrastructure for trustless, privacy-first AI: Era on edge inference and open-source composable stacks, Ming on verifiable compute via zkVM. Worth a conversation on how these pieces fit together.
